enrichment method: EVs were collected from the supernatant of Giardia, with 1 × 106/mL parasites incubated in TYI-S-33 medium with exosome-depleted serum at 37 °C for 12 h. The supernatant was collected and centrifuged at 400 g for 10 min to eliminate parasites, at 8500 g for 60 min to remove debris, followed by filtration through a 0.22 μm sterilized PES membrane (Merck Millipore, USA), and then further ultracentrifuged at 120,000 g for 1.5 h or using the exoEasy Kit (QIAGEN).
labeling: The proteins involved in EVs formation were detected in the EVs of Giardia+GLV by proteomic and western blotting analysis, incuding Rab 2a, Rab 11, and HSP 90 (Supplementary Fig. 3A).
